# laravelcloud_database_schemas (Resource)

Manages a database (schema) within a Laravel Cloud database cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_database_schemas" "example" {
  database = "database-id"
  name     = "example-name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) The database this resource belongs to.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `schema` (String) The schema identifier

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_database_schemas.example database-id/the-id
```
